recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14083 unless the work group reopens the later MeasureReport score or stratum value type decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-14083 was a Published/Persuasive CQI STU3 change request for FHIR-core MeasureReport. It requested changing MeasureReport measureScore elements to Quantity and changing the stratum value element to CodeableConcept.
initial_application: Jira records the change as applied at SVN 12641. Git commit 734c7befc75fc6677ab2dbae8d77bdc07428cc5b explicitly references #14083 and changed MeasureReport.group.measureScore and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.measureScore from decimal to Quantity and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.value from string to CodeableConcept.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later final CQI decisions broadened the same choice-type family: FHIR-22824 added dateTime, CodeableConcept, Period, Range, and Duration score choices; FHIR-46238 added boolean; FHIR-50174 added Ratio; and FHIR-26647 broadened stratum value choices beyond CodeableConcept.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition source already includes Quantity in both measureScore[x] type lists and CodeableConcept in stratum value[x], while retaining later approved choice-type expansions.
